name: adze-vscode
description: Adze in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. The engine runs in-process; the extension renders.

adze.model.markdownDescription: Model to use, as `provider/model` (for example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`). Empty means the provider configuration decides. Credentials are never read from settings — see `adze.credentials` in the README.

enumDescriptions: The agent may read but never write or run commands that write.
The agent may write inside the workspace root.
adze.sandbox.mode.markdownDescription: What the agent is permitted to do. On Windows there is no OS-level containment, so this is enforced by the permission gate alone; the extension says so rather than letting you infer a boundary that is not there. An unrecognised value falls back to `read-only`, never to the default.

enumDescriptions: Ask before anything the gate cannot already authorise.
Ask only for what the sandbox would otherwise block.
Never ask. An action needing approval is refused, not escalated.
adze.approvals.policy.markdownDescription: When you are asked to approve an action. `never` **refuses rather than escalating**. An unrecognised value falls back to `never`, never to the default, so a typo cannot grant more than you asked for.

adze.budget.maxSteps.markdownDescription: Maximum model round-trips per turn. `null` means unbounded. Must be a positive integer; `0` is rejected rather than treated as unbounded.

adze.budget.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum total tokens per turn. `null` means unbounded.

adze.budget.maxWallClockMs.markdownDescription: Wall-clock ceiling per turn, in milliseconds. `null` means unbounded.

adze.budget.maxSpendUsd.markdownDescription: Spend ceiling per turn, in USD. `null` means unbounded. `0` is a valid value and means no spend is permitted.

adze.inlineCompletion.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer ghost-text completions as you type. **Off by default**: the protocol has no cheap-completion message, so each suggestion costs a full turn against your configured provider. Turning this on is opting into billed requests you did not explicitly trigger.

adze.inlineCompletion.debounceMs.markdownDescription: How long typing must pause before a ghost-text request is issued.

adze.inlineCompletion.maxPrefixBytes.markdownDescription: How much text before the cursor is sent with a ghost-text request.

adze.instructions.markdownDescription: Extra instructions prepended to every session, the equivalent of an `AGENTS.md` fragment.
